scope: Independent read-only validation of one captured calc_p_rho_phi vector lane in each of OLD_SHAM_RETRY1/B1, GROUPED/B1, and GROUPED/DM065. This is operation attribution, not a full forecast or science admission.
independent_checks: Recomputed the REAL32 lane arithmetic from captured PH/PHnext/PHB/PHBnext words and compared each intermediate with the recorded SIMD registers through first division.
Checked the actual operation instruction bytes/order and their executable-specific plan bindings.
Checked target Fortran memory addresses against vector bases, index offset and the recorded lane.
Checked the pre-store AL candidate word equals the post-store memory word at the target AL address.
Checked all three operation receipts, event hashes, current case-receipt pins, eight rank success markers, unchanged case inputs, and h00 byte parity.
attribution: The observed OLD_SHAM lane evaluates (((PHnext-PH)+PHBnext)-PHB); the GROUPED lanes evaluate ((PHnext-PH)+(PHBnext-PHB)). The captured numerator words differ for these operands. This demonstrates compiled-operation order at one matched cell/call in these three cases only.

prior_failed_attempt.failure: Probe JSON serialization failed on a bytes-valued lane word after reaching the AL store breakpoint. This attempt is preserved separately and was not counted as a passing capture.

limitations: One cell and one matching call per case; no cohort or global forecast attribution.
B1 captures were independently replayed retrospectively from preserved actual run events; DM065 used the corrected runner.
The C/D six-hour forecasts are separate experiments; this review does not validate their outputs or the 52 score gates.
